summary.text: Chaotic Heart Drumming Sound is an immortal killer move Heavenly Court gave Feng Jiu Ge. Drumming from his chest spreads across the battlefield as an area attack.

claims.text: He places his right palm on his left chest, by his heart, and his five fingers strung on his chest, making light and deep drumming sounds that continue across the whole field. He does not need to pick Fang Yuan out among myriad dragons. The range is huge. Fang Yuan is hit. His heart pounds and his momentum goes out of control. Reverse flow protection seal reflects most of the effect; a small bit penetrates. Heavenly Court has made some gains in deciphering that seal. The move has wisdom path effects. Once hit, a Gu Immortal’s thoughts are disrupted and their killer moves would not be sustainable. Dragons around Fang Yuan self-detonate. Inside the sovereign immortal aperture, myriad self clones that have self will and wisdom path cognition also self-detonate into white smoke. Fang Yuan judges that the move was designed to target him. Almost every breath, dozens more clones die who were not harmed by this killer move. Most of those die from sustaining reverse flow protection seal and ancient sword dragon transformation. Activating myriad dragon earlier had already cost a thousand. He has prepared more than a million clones, so the loss of a few thousand is inconsequential, and he tells himself the move is not enough.

When Feng Jiu Ge meets two Heavenly Court rank eight Gu Immortals near the Western Desert tributary of the River of Time, this move has been modified by Fairy Zi Wei again. It is the trump card to deal with Fang Yuan.
